title: Echoes_of_Hope_and_Dawn
description:
Pairing: Anakin Skywalker/Obi-Wan Kenobi

Obi-Wan successfully brought Anakin (Vader) back, and Anakin... well, sort of returned to the Light Side (maybe). And so, this master and apprentice pair travel across the galaxy in their starship, embarking on adventure after adventure — helping others, seeking redemption, facing their past... Ah, but after all that's been said, this is still a smut fic. So, most of the time... they're just banging :)
